turns.question: On which day of the week were the most orders placed between 17 August and 27 September 2026, and how many orders were placed on that weekday in total?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no day-of-week grain, so I cannot give the weekday with the most orders or its total without computing it myself; the closest figures are daily order counts (orders placed, cancelled included), which run 3, 4 or 5 orders a day from 17 August to 27 September 2026.
